CHANGELOG updated in BRAWLPIT: S449: Hyperbot-style real-time half-life discounting scales the S442 inactivity penalty up as the match clock runs down (new time_pressure_multiplier()); S450: fixed a real --fast-forward busy-spin bug in apps/server/src/main.c (idle CPU ~100% -> ~0%) by blocking on select() instead of a tight non-blocking recvfrom() loop, making the server genuinely event-driven (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
